response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), satisfying RET-020, which at priority 90 dominates the out-of-window rule RET-008 (priority 10). Final-sale (RET-012) does not apply since final_sale is False, and no goodwill/fraud holds are active. Thus the defective item is eligible for return regardless of the 63 days elapsed.
